resumeshield.skipped: not run: ResumeShield (github.com/jbarach2012/ResumeShield, arXiv:2609.20188) generates its 104 documents as HTML strings (resumeshield/benchmark/corpus.py), while HireGuard only accepts PDFs. Rendering them to PDF would not preserve the attacks (display:none, HTML comments simply vanish), so the PDF equivalents of its techniques are covered by our own 40-attack corpus instead.
